scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/cli && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.golden:tier0: npm run build && vitest run tests/tier0-golden.test.ts
scripts.golden:tier1a: npm run build && vitest run tests/tier1a-golden.test.ts
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build -w apps/desktop && playwright test --project=renderer
scripts.test:electron: npm run build -w apps/desktop && playwright test --project=electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/cli && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
